name: datetime
description: Get current date/time in any IANA timezone, or convert a timestamp. No network, no key — pure runtime. Use when the user asks 'what time is it in X?' or wants to coordinate across timezones.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Karachi', 'America/New_York', 'UTC'). Defaults to UTC if omitted.

author: aashir-athar
